question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS year_num
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_num,
        year_num,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM delivered_orders
    WHERE year_num IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY month_num, year_num
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num
    UNION ALL SELECT 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
    am.month_num,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2016 THEN mc.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS year_2016,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2017 THEN mc.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS year_2017,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mc.year_num = 2018 THEN mc.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS year_2018
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON am.month_num = mc.month_num
GROUP BY am.month_num
ORDER BY am.month_num
